text:
nora kim: FYI a prospect asked for a concrete acceptance checklist for audit logs + BYOK + retention tiers. they need something we can sign off in the SOW. quick sync?

alan choi: short list from sales: 1) canonical audit schema, 2) per-tenant retention policies, 3) exportable evidence bundles, 4) clear BYOK behavior and any escrow path, 5) SLA for export readiness.

meera patel (legal): callouts: escrow must be opt-in and contracted, unwraps require two-person approval and an auditable justification string. cross-border export constraints must be explicit in the SOW.

jason (sales): prospect insists on 24h export SLA for legal hold. can we commit?

mike huang: technical reality: depends on dataset size and whether we need to perform KMS operations. propose we split SLA: metadata-only exports (24h), full decrypted exports with escrow/KMS ops (72h). document as negotiable enterprise SLA.

alan choi: schema proposal from eng: each log entry must include: ts, eid, tenant, actor, action, resource, result, req_id, src_ip, ua, key_id?, key_ver?, hash. want to make key fields optional but required when crypto ops present.

nora kim: agree. also include integrity checkpoints: hourly signed roots (merkle) stored in an immutable bucket. that gives tamper evidence without per-entry signatures.

meera patel (legal): require immutable manifest for exports: export_id, tenant_id, from_ts, to_ts, merkle_root, signature, approval_id, escrow_used=true|false. approval_id must link to contract-approved approver.

mike huang: BYOK behaviors: - hosted keys: platform can produce decrypted bundle and sign it. - BYOK (customer keys): platform provides ciphertext + key_id + key_version in export; customer must decrypt. - escrow: only if addendum signed; unwrap token flow must be timebound and logged.

jason (sales): we'll push escrow as an optional premium feature. prospect prefers escrow but their legal team will need the addendum.

alan choi: API surface minimal sketch: POST /v1/tenants/:id/hold {action:apply|release, reason, approver_id}, POST /v1/tenants/:id/export {from,to,include_payload:true|false, escrow:optional}, GET /v1/exports/:id/manifest. header X-Key-Id accepted for BYOK metadata.

nora kim: rollout recommendation: 1) internal alpha (ops-only) to validate snapshot/export flow and merkle checkpointing, 2) controlled pilot w/ 1 BYOK and 1 hosted-key customer, 3) GA with console + SLA hooks. estimate 6-10 weeks to pilot depending on legal turnaround.

meera patel (legal): i'll draft a short addendum checklist for escrow and unwrap approval matrix. note: any unwrap that crosses regions must trigger legal review.

mike huang: risk notes for PRD: cost delta for long retention, performance hit for frequent checkpointing, key lifecycle mismatch if customer rotates keys frequently. include mitigation: acceptance tests for rotated key handling and export replay tests.

jason (sales): i'll ask prospect to sign a letter-of-intent to prioritize this into our roadmap. that's the gating item.

ci-bot: Pipeline: feature/audit-export-checkpoints build 210 succeeded. :white_check_mark:

nora kim: action items: alan -> short PRD bullets for schema + API, meera -> escrow addendum draft, mike -> rollout & risk bullets, jason -> LOI from prospect. please post by EOD PST.

alan choi: will do. posting sample manifest example in PRD after this thread.

meera patel (legal): noted. I'll include approval clause examples.

jason (sales): thanks everyone, will push for LOI.

nora kim: thanks all — i'll assemble and share a draft playbook to send to the customer tomorrow morning.
